claims_ingested.statement: LLM accuracy degrades non-uniformly as input length grows
Degradation accelerates as needle-question semantic similarity decreases
A single distractor lowers performance vs needle-only; four distractors compound it
Models score higher on shuffled haystacks than logically-structured ones
Focused (~300 tok) prompts beat full (~113k tok) prompts across all models on LongMemEval
A skill should be admitted only when a benchmark shows it beats baseline and generalizes beyond its eval examples
Before writing tests, discover the repo's own framework/build/commands
Code written before its corresponding test should be deleted
A maintenance loop should run report-only for its first week before being allowed to act
Agent jobs run read-only and sandboxed by default; writes go through scoped safe-outputs jobs
Trimming MCP tool context to task-relevant reduced context ~69% weighted-avg with 100% sufficiency on 5 eligible cases (author benchmark)
A code fix is verified iff it flips FAIL_TO_PASS while keeping PASS_TO_PASS green in a pinned environment
OWASP treats passwords <15 chars as weak without MFA (<8 with MFA), and requires identical error text + constant time for bad-user vs bad-password
DFSDT (a depth-first decision tree allowing backtracking) improves LLM planning on multi-tool tasks vs linear planning
Client-side constraint validation is a UX layer only; the same rules must be enforced server-side
